name: Gilroy Premium Outlets - Building D
summary: Gilroy Premium Outlets - Building D is part of one of Northern California's most popular outlet shopping destinations, offering designer and name-brand merchandise at significant discounts. Located conveniently off Highway 101 in Gilroy, the center attracts shoppers from throughout the San Francisco Bay Area seeking premium brands at outlet prices.
demographics: Gilroy Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of bargain-seeking shoppers, including middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The center draws heavily from the San Francisco Bay Area, appealing to value-conscious millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-55 who appreciate designer brands at discounted prices. The trade area extends throughout Silicon Valley and the greater Bay Area, with many visitors making it a destination shopping trip, often combining their visit with wine country tours or weekend getaways. The demographic skews toward educated professionals and families who are brand-aware but price-sensitive, seeking quality merchandise at outlet pricing.
description: Gilroy Premium Outlets - Building D is part of the renowned Gilroy Premium Outlets shopping destination, one of California's premier outlet shopping centers located in the heart of Gilroy. As part of the Simon Premium Outlets portfolio, this facility offers shoppers access to an extensive collection of designer and name-brand outlet stores featuring savings of 25% to 65% every day. The center has established itself as a major shopping destination for Bay Area residents and tourists alike, drawing millions of visitors annually who travel from San Francisco, San Jose, and throughout Northern California. Building D contributes to the overall outlet experience, housing a curated selection of retailers that complement the center's diverse tenant mix of fashion, accessories, home goods, and lifestyle brands. The location's convenient access from Highway 101 and its proximity to California's wine country makes it an ideal stop for both serious shoppers and casual visitors seeking quality brands at exceptional values.
